panel.not_configured: Set the Vikunja URL and API token under Settings → Plugins → Vikunja.
panel.subtitle: Tasks due today and overdue
panel.projects_hint: Pick a project to see its tasks.

result.no_project: No project to add to — set a default project in the plugin settings.

api_token.description: Settings → API Tokens in Vikunja. Needs projects:read and tasks:read, plus tasks:create and tasks:update for add/complete/postpone.
api_token.label: API token

base_url.description: Vikunja origin only, e.g. https://vikunja.example.com (no trailing /api).
base_url.label: Base URL

default_project.description: Project (name or numeric id) that quick add and /vk add use. Empty picks the first project.
default_project.label: Default project

notify_on_due.description: Desktop notification when a task becomes overdue.
notify_on_due.label: Notify when tasks become overdue

show_label.description: Display the today/overdue count next to the icon.
show_label.label: Show count on bar

soon_days.description: How many days ahead the Upcoming tab and the widget lookahead cover.
soon_days.label: Upcoming window (days)

timezone.description: IANA time zone used for “today”, day boundaries and due dates sent to Vikunja. Empty uses the server's zone.
timezone.label: Time zone

widget.tooltip_missing: Set the Vikunja URL and API token under Settings → Plugins → Vikunja.
